items.Sentence: The subsurface disposal system was originally proposed to consist of four zones (Zones A, B, C, and D) located under Fairway 7 of the Wawona Golf Course... When discharging to the subsurface disposal system, Discharger shall comply with all applicable requirements specified in the General Order and NOA R5-2014-0153-DWQ. This includes complying with the biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and total suspended solids (TSS) limits of 10 mg/L (monthly average) and 20 mg/L (daily maximum), the total coliform limits of 2.2 MPN/100 mL (7-day median), 23 MPN/ 100 mL (30-day average), and 240 MPN/100 mL (at any time), and the total nitrogen annual limit reduction of 50%.
